title: Enrolment paper.–(1) Any enrolment paper purporting to be signed by an enrolling officer
text:
107. Enrolment paper.–(1) Any enrolment paper purporting to be signed by an enrolling officer
shall, in proceedings under this Act, be evidence of the person enrolling having given the answers to
questions which he is therein represented as having given.

(2) The enrolment of such person may be proved by the production of the original or a copy of this
enrolment paper purporting to be certified to be a true copy by the office having the custody of the
enrolment paper or service record.
